items.message: Branch steps are recorded after `gather` returns, not inside the branch coroutine, so a branch that raises `CancelledError` without being converted (kill-switch check returns False) leaves no step on the parent run.
`release()` uses `max(0, …)` guards, which silently absorb a double-release instead of raising.
